# GitHub CLI Extension Atlas

> Curated field guide to GitHub CLI extensions: what to install, when to use them, and which ones are maintained.

Repository: https://github.com/sjh9714/gh-extension-atlas
Website: https://sjh9714.github.io/gh-extension-atlas/
Reviewed snapshot: 2026-06-08
Catalog size: 68 extensions
Status counts: 49 active, 9 watch, 10 stale

## Purpose

Use this atlas when `gh extension search` gives too many options and you need a faster first choice. The project combines human curation, comparison guides, starter packs, generated extension detail pages, and a small public JSON catalog.

This is not an official GitHub project, complete directory, endorsement list, or live ranking. Recheck upstream repositories before adopting a tool for security, compliance, CI, release, or production workflows.

## Top Picks

- dash (dlvhdr/gh-dash) - Maintainers who live in PR, issue, and notification queues. Install: `gh extension install dlvhdr/gh-dash`. Detail: https://sjh9714.github.io/gh-extension-atlas/extensions/dlvhdr-gh-dash.html
- aw (github/gh-aw) - Developers experimenting with GitHub-native agent workflows. Install: `gh extension install github/gh-aw`. Detail: https://sjh9714.github.io/gh-extension-atlas/extensions/github-gh-aw.html
- stack (github/gh-stack) - Teams that split large changes into dependent PRs. Install: `gh extension install github/gh-stack`. Detail: https://sjh9714.github.io/gh-extension-atlas/extensions/github-gh-stack.html
- poi (seachicken/gh-poi) - Developers who want a trustworthy branch cleanup default. Install: `gh extension install seachicken/gh-poi`. Detail: https://sjh9714.github.io/gh-extension-atlas/extensions/seachicken-gh-poi.html
- markdown-preview (yusukebe/gh-markdown-preview) - README, issue template, and documentation review. Install: `gh extension install yusukebe/gh-markdown-preview`. Detail: https://sjh9714.github.io/gh-extension-atlas/extensions/yusukebe-gh-markdown-preview.html
- sbom (advanced-security/gh-sbom) - Teams that need SBOM output during release or compliance work. Install: `gh extension install advanced-security/gh-sbom`. Detail: https://sjh9714.github.io/gh-extension-atlas/extensions/advanced-security-gh-sbom.html
- s (gennaro-tedesco/gh-s) - Finding repositories quickly from a terminal workflow. Install: `gh extension install gennaro-tedesco/gh-s`. Detail: https://sjh9714.github.io/gh-extension-atlas/extensions/gennaro-tedesco-gh-s.html
- notify (meiji163/gh-notify) - Developers who want notification awareness without the browser. Install: `gh extension install meiji163/gh-notify`. Detail: https://sjh9714.github.io/gh-extension-atlas/extensions/meiji163-gh-notify.html
- pr-review (agynio/gh-pr-review) - Reviewers who want inline PR review workflows in the terminal. Install: `gh extension install agynio/gh-pr-review`. Detail: https://sjh9714.github.io/gh-extension-atlas/extensions/agynio-gh-pr-review.html
- workflow-stats (fchimpan/gh-workflow-stats) - CI owners investigating slow or flaky workflows. Install: `gh extension install fchimpan/gh-workflow-stats`. Detail: https://sjh9714.github.io/gh-extension-atlas/extensions/fchimpan-gh-workflow-stats.html

## Starter Packs

- Daily Maintainer Triage: PRs, issues, review threads, and notifications from the terminal. Install bundle: https://sjh9714.github.io/gh-extension-atlas/install/starter-packs/daily-maintainer-triage.txt Repos: dlvhdr/gh-dash, agynio/gh-pr-review, meiji163/gh-notify
- PR Review And Issue Triage: Inline PR review, stacked PRs, and dependency update queues. Install bundle: https://sjh9714.github.io/gh-extension-atlas/install/starter-packs/pr-review-and-issue-triage.txt Repos: agynio/gh-pr-review, github/gh-stack, einride/gh-dependabot
- GitHub Actions Operator: Interactive workflow inspection plus CI health and migration helpers. Install bundle: https://sjh9714.github.io/gh-extension-atlas/install/starter-packs/github-actions-operator.txt Repos: dlvhdr/gh-enhance, fchimpan/gh-workflow-stats, github/gh-actions-importer
- AI And Agents: GitHub agent workflows, Models, standup summaries, and MCP setup. Install bundle: https://sjh9714.github.io/gh-extension-atlas/install/starter-packs/ai-and-agents.txt Repos: github/gh-aw, github/gh-models, shuymn/gh-mcp
- Local Repository Cleanup: Safer branch cleanup, fuzzy branch switching, and release binary installs. Install bundle: https://sjh9714.github.io/gh-extension-atlas/install/starter-packs/local-repository-cleanup.txt Repos: seachicken/gh-poi, mislav/gh-branch, redraw/gh-install
- Documentation Review: GitHub-flavored Markdown preview before publishing README or docs changes. Install bundle: https://sjh9714.github.io/gh-extension-atlas/install/starter-packs/documentation-review.txt Repos: yusukebe/gh-markdown-preview, thiagokokada/gh-gfm-preview
- Search And Discovery: Repository discovery, API-backed grep, and interactive code search. Install bundle: https://sjh9714.github.io/gh-extension-atlas/install/starter-packs/search-and-discovery.txt Repos: gennaro-tedesco/gh-s, k1LoW/gh-grep, LangLangBart/gh-find-code
- Security And Admin: SBOM generation, GitHub App tokens, and enterprise migration workflows. Install bundle: https://sjh9714.github.io/gh-extension-atlas/install/starter-packs/security-and-admin.txt Repos: advanced-security/gh-sbom, Link-/gh-token, github/gh-gei

- Dashboard/TUI: Choose a GitHub terminal dashboard, Markdown preview TUI, or visual contribution tool. - Notifications: Choose a terminal notification viewer, rules helper, cleanup tool, or broader triage dashboard. - Search: Choose a repository search, code search, starred-repository, or local clone helper. Guide: https://sjh9714.github.io/gh-extension-atlas/guides/repository-search-extensions.html Category page: https://sjh9714.github.io/gh-extension-atlas/categories/search.html Category JSON: https://sjh9714.github.io/gh-extension-atlas/api/categories/search.json
